text: Setting up Palivane takes one command, and one afternoon for the whole org.
From the Connect page, generate a capture key and pick your platform.
Run palivane-connect on a laptop. Claude Code, Cursor, the hooks and the browser extension are configured, in monitor mode.
Settings hold the policy: what to block, what to route, who gets alerted.
To cover the fleet, push the policy pack through Jamf, Intune or Group Policy. No agent to install.
Findings start arriving as people work. Watch for a week, then switch on enforcement for the checks that proved right.
